initiative.title: Sell explorEDA commercial licenses
initiative.summary: Close every gap between today (unlicensed package, static site, no payments) and a self-serve paid commercial license with offline signed keys, a merchant of record, a small license service, and buyer-trust material.
initiative.next_action: Byron confirms the single source-available package model and names the selling entity and lawyer; then build M1 (key codec and package license states) locally.

sources.anchor: paid component for enterprise uses, like Handsontable; need server, need payments; close it all in one go; easy to get their money; certain they are licensed correctly
open core recommendation, comparables, price sheet, legal checklist, ranked readiness gaps
sources.authority: research; recommendation to wait is superseded by SRC-1

sources.anchor: no LICENSE, npm 0.1.0, Version Packages PR #41 open, GitHub Pages deploy, registerAllCharts at import, no fetch calls, 164 --worktree commits
Paddle sales-assisted invoices: drafts, bank transfer, auto-created subscription

claims.text: Companies using explorEDA commercially pay for a license, Handsontable/AG Grid style.
Self-serve purchase by card with an invoice/PO path; no manual step for Byron on ordinary orders.
Purchaser can verify they are licensed: key names licensee, in-app status, CLI check, certificate.
Close all gaps in one initiative rather than a staged adoption experiment.
Offline enforcement; a key problem never breaks production.
Single source-available package rather than MIT core plus paid superset.

conflicts.text: Research says wait ~90 days and grow an MIT core; Byron wants to charge now. Resolved in favor of SRC-1; research kept for prices and mechanics.

human_questions.text: Confirm single source-available package (Handsontable) over MIT core plus paid package (AG Grid).
Selling entity (individual or LLC) and lawyer for license, commercial terms, CLA.

shape.appetite: One initiative ending in a live paid purchase; engineering is a key module, a small serverless service, and static pages.
shape.problem: No license, no checkout, no key, no server, no buyer-facing trust material.
shape.recommended_shape: Single source-available package with offline Ed25519 keys and a watermark; MoR handles checkout, tax, invoices; Cloudflare Worker + D1 issues keys, certificates, trials, and a portal; static pricing and legal pages on exploreda.dev.

success_moves.move: Single package under a source-available license instead of splitting code into a paid package
success_moves.benefit: Removes the largest code move; restrictive-first is the reversible direction

success_moves.move: Shared license codec package with test vectors used by package, CLI, and service
Build the service against a fake MoR and file mailer before opening any account
success_moves.benefit: Account review never blocks engineering; failure cases are replayable

success_moves.move: Merchant of record owns payment, tax, invoices, billing portal
success_moves.benefit: No card data or tax logic in Byron code
No customer outage from a key bug; simpler security review

success_moves.move: Start legal and repo-hygiene drafts in M2 in parallel
success_moves.benefit: Lawyer and MoR review overlap engineering

first_proof.question: Do the four license states read clearly and agree across app, console, and CLI with no network call?
first_proof.artifact: Local demo with dev-keypair keys at three widths plus CLI exit codes
first_proof.decision_rule: Clear and consistent: build the service on the codec. Intrusive or ambiguous: fix notice UX before payment work.

rabbit_holes: Building checkout, tax, or invoicing in-house
Moving features into a second package
Custom license text written from scratch

test_commands: pnpm --filter exploreda exec vitest run src/license
